programs.name: Post Graduate Programme in Management (PGP) leading to award of MBA
programs.feeNote: Course fee for CAT students, batch 2026-28 (INR 12 lakh x 2). With caution deposit, mess deposit and alumni fee the stated year totals add up to INR 25,15,800.

feeSource.title: IIM Indore - PGP Fee Structure, Fees Structure for PGP Batch 2026-28 (updated 09 January 2026)
feeSource.quote: Fees Structure for PGP Batch 2026-28 ... For Indian Students through CAT ... Course Fee | 12,00,000 (AY 2026-27) | 12,00,000 (AY 2027-28) ... Grand Total | 13,04,000 | 12,11,800 ... Course fee does not include cost of text books.

programs.intakeNote: NIRF 2025 sanctioned intake (academic year 2023-24) for all 2-year PG programmes of the institute combined, not only this programme. May include IPM students in their PG years.

intakeSource.title: NIRF India Rankings 2025 - Data submitted by institution (Indian Institute of Management Indore) [IR-M-S-8918]
intakeSource.quote: Sanctioned (Approved) Intake ... Academic Year 2023-24 2022-23 ... PG [2 Year Program(s)] 633 635

programs.salaryNote: Class of 2026: 586 graduates (492 MBA and 94 IPM dual-degree) combined; no PGP-only median published.

salarySource.title: IIM Indore Consolidated Placement Report - Final Placement Report 2024-26 (PGP and IPM)
salarySource.quote: IIM Indore successfully concluded its Final Placements for the Class of 2026 ... Average and median packages stood strong at ₹27.27 Lakhs and ₹25.00 Lakhs, respectively.
